Crystal formation has occurred when enoxi- mone injection was mixed in glass containers or syringes; the manufacturer recommends that only plastic containers or syring- es are used for dilutions. The manufacturer also recommends that only sodium chloride 0.9% or water be used as diluents. Glucose solutions should not be used for dilution as crystal formation may occur. Adverse Effects Long-term oral treatment with enoximone has been re- ported to increase the mortality rate and enoximone is now only given intravenously for short-term use.
